cases.message: @createOnly on a mutation takes one or more strings
@createOnly is only valid on insert mutations

cases.note: A write-shaping annotation names a top-level field of the concept the mutation writes: the executor keys on the name, so one the concept does not declare is never met and the annotation silently does nothing (memql#5426).

cases.message: @createOnly("attempts") names a field this mutation's insert block does not write
cases.note: A field the write never carries is already kept by the read-merge, so naming it here protects nothing; the annotation is refused rather than left to read as a guarantee (memql#5426).
